verdict.rationale: Visa documents REST API reference pages with endpoints, test/production hosts, required fields, and sample payloads (purchase intent, card enrollment, credential retrieval). It also ships runnable material: the Trusted Agent Protocol reference implementation repo, signature code snippets, and a self-serve sandbox for sending test transactions. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, in-browser API explorer or a try-it console. missing for 10: an interactive API reference / try-it console, runnable examples embedded in the Intelligent Commerce API reference itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the docs experience.
